name: Arctic Wolf

specialAbility.name: Pack Hunt
specialAbility.description: Howls and summons two ghost wolves that charge in for bonus attacks, each hitting for half damage!

lore: Arctic Wolf comes howling out of a frozen blizzard, its icy white body covered in cool blue tribal wolf markings! It's fast, it's fierce, and it never hunts alone. When it activates Pack Hunt, two glowing ice-blue ghost wolves burst out from behind it and all three attack at once — WHAM WHAM WHAM! Three hits for the price of one! The pack always wins!
